hero.title: Great ventures start with better questions.
hero.intro: Discover your strengths, notice problems that matter, and choose an opportunity worth exploring. You don’t need a business idea to begin.

children: Four modules. Five lessons each. Build something useful at every step.
Is this problem worth exploring further?

Bring together your founder profile, problem journal, customer snapshot, research notes, and opportunity assessment. Your Opportunity Brief should name a customer, a problem, current alternatives, and the assumptions to test in Validate.
